bull_case: AI improves the core ad engine while Threads, WhatsApp, subscriptions, agents and wearables create additional monetization vectors. A roughly 2x-plus 5-year economic expansion is possible without heroic margins.
bear_case: Starting scale is enormous, advertising is already mature, and current valuation reflects much of the expected AI/ad runway. New businesses may remain too small while capex and regulation constrain cash compounding.
thesis: META has a credible 5-10 year growth runway but does not clear the harness's outlier-growth expectation-gap bar at the cutoff. A roughly 2.2x five-year economic expansion is plausible if mid-teens growth persists and new monetization layers contribute, but the market already prices near the EV Base case. Culture/adaptability is strong; the weak link is a specific market misperception, not the size of the business opportunity.

evidence.claim: FY2025 revenue grew 22% and Q2 2026 revenue grew 28%; EV's frozen next-3-year revenue CAGR estimate is 16%, which supports a multi-year growth runway.
FoA other revenue grew 50% in 2025, driven mainly by WhatsApp paid messaging and Meta Verified; Reality Labs AI-glasses sales also contributed growth.
Reuters reported on September 15, 2026 that Meta One had 15M subscribers and trial users during phased rollout, providing an early subscription growth vector.

The harness EV Base value is about $638/share versus a frozen price of $665.75, so price/Base is about 1.043x. The market therefore already discounts roughly the Base growth path rather than a short-duration miss.
Meta has shifted product and capital toward Reels, AI recommendation, Threads, subscriptions and a major AI infrastructure build while continuing to grow the core business.

counterevidence: At roughly $1.7T market cap, maintaining mid-teens growth for many years is mathematically demanding.
Advertising remains roughly 98% of revenue, so new vectors are not yet economically independent at scale.
AI capex may remain structurally high and reduce owner-cash-flow conversion.
The frozen price is already above the EV Base value, weakening the expectation-gap thesis.
unknowns: Meta does not provide long-term revenue guidance by Threads, WhatsApp, Meta One, agents or enterprise AI.
No matched consensus/reverse-DCF dataset was frozen beyond the harness EV scenarios to prove the market is underestimating duration.
falsifiers: Revenue CAGR falls below 10% before new monetization pools become material.
New products remain below a few percent of revenue through 2029 while ad growth matures.
Price continues to require Base-or-better assumptions while owner FCF/share fails to recover.

key_kpis.name: Non-ad/new-product revenue
key_kpis.threshold: become material enough to diversify the growth engine

next_checks: Update five-year expansion multiple after 2027 revenue/capex guidance.
Quantify revenue from Threads, WhatsApp, subscriptions and enterprise AI as disclosure improves.
Re-run market_misperception if price falls materially or owner FCF recovery exceeds Base.

subscores.rationale: A roughly 2.2x five-year economic expansion is plausible with mid-teens growth plus new monetization vectors. Interpolation in the 2.0-3.0x band is around 70, below 75 because advertising concentration and starting scale limit confidence.

A 5-10 year runway is plausible from AI monetization, messaging and subscriptions, but 10+ years of high-value growth is not sufficiently proven at current scale. This places the score within, but below the center of, the 5-10 year band.

Meta has repeatedly reallocated resources and self-disrupted across mobile, Stories/Reels, efficiency and AI. Founder control is not treated as proof by itself; observed product/capital pivots support a score above the 75 anchor but below 90.

A concrete underpriced expectation gap is weak: frozen price/Base is about 1.043x and EV concludes the market discounts essentially the Base runway. This fits the 50 plausible-disagreement anchor, not the 75 misperception threshold.

uncertainties.rationale: The 2.2x path depends on sustaining mid-teens growth from a very large base.
New monetization vectors are not yet large enough to prove a decade-long runway.
Historical adaptability is strong; the newest AI-agent strategy has limited operating history.
No external consensus distribution or independent reverse-DCF benchmark is frozen to establish a stronger expectation gap.
